tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rje btsun ras pa chen po la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshogs mchod dang bcas pa ye shes dpal 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /rje btsun ras pa chen po la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshogs mchod dang bcas pa ye shes dpal 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#"U ༄༅// rje btsun ras pa chen po la brten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor tshogs mchod dang bcas pa ye shes dpal 'bar zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang ni// sku tshe gcig gis mngon mdzad pa// gangs can grub pa'i dbang phyug la// btud nas de yi rnal 'byor 'chad// bsam gtan dang rjes su mthun pa'i gnas su nges 'byung dang skyo shas drag pos rgyud bskul/ mos gus dus mtha'i me'i shugs bzhin du spar/ byang chub sems rin po che rnam pa gnyis la blo mngon du bzhag ste/ 'byor na stegs gtsang mar maṇḍal tshom bus spras pa dang nyer spyod mchod pa'i bkod pa ji ltar tshogs pa bsham/ ma 'byor na ting nge 'dzin kho nas kyang 'grub la/ tshogs mchod dang 'brel na de'i yo byad thabs shes kyi rdzas sogs nye bar bsdogs/ de'i tshe thog mar sngon gtor bshams la/ rang nyid skad cig rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// dmar mo gri thod phyag rgyas spras par gyur// bdud rtsi ril bu dang ldan pa'i myos byed kyis gang ba'i ka pā la mdun du bzhag pa la dmigs te/ oṃ āḥbighnanta kṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā ba shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā ba shuddho3 haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me thod sgyed steng*// mtshan ldan bhañdzar go ku da ha na// bi mu ma ra shu las sha lnga dang*// bdud rtsi lngar gyur rlung mes zhu zhing bskol// 'bru gsum 'od kyis ye shes bdud rtsi bkug /dam ye gnyis med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum gyis myang*/ gtor ma'ang de ltar brlab la/ 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ/ zhes mgron dgug / oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa rakṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi sha tsa unma da a pa sma ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+yā da ya/ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛhnantu/ sa ma ya rakṣantu/ ma ma sarba siddhi mme pra ya tstshantu/ ya thai baṃ/ ya thaiṣṭaṃḥ bhūñdza tha/ dzi ghra tha/ pi ba tha/ ma ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā ra ta ya sata su khaṃ bi shuddha sa hā yi gaṃ bha wantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ sngags lan gsum gyis bsngos la gtor ma dor/

gang dag nag po'i phyogs gyur pa'i// gsang sngags zab mo'i cho ga la// nyan dang lta bar mi dbang ba// de dag thams cad gzhan du dengs// gal te bka' las 'da' byed na// rdo rje kha ṭwaṃ' rab 'bar bas// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas 'gyur/ oṃ sumbha ni sogs kyi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes srung ba'i 'khor lo gsal gdab/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor lta bur de yan chad mi dgos so// skyabs sems ni/ bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun// dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum gyi dngos// dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rje la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ ma gyur sems can mtha' dag rnams// rje btsun ras pa chen po yi// go 'phang bla med 'thob bya'i phyir// sgo gsum dge la bkol bar bya// lan gsum/ rang sems bla mar rtogs pas gus phyag 'tshal// tshogs drug zhen pa bral ba'i mchod pa 'bul// gnyis 'dzin a 'thas rang rig klong du bshags// thugs rje rgyun chad med la yi rang ngo// khyab bdal ye shes chos 'khor bskor du gsol// mchog tu mi 'gyur chos skur bzhugs gsol 'debs// mkha' khyab 'gro kun sku gsum thob phyir bsngo// 'khor ba dong sprugs 'gro don 'grub par shog / ces yan lag bdun pa bya/ rang byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang snang rnam dag mkha' spyod o rgyan zhing*// chos 'byung pad nyi ro steng skad cig gis// rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo li khri'i mdangs// gri gug thod khrag phyag rgya lnga yis spras// kha ṭwaṃ' g.yon brten zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum tshul// me dpung dbus bzhugs lte bar e dbus su// don kun sgrub byed 'khor lo 'od 'bar ba'o// zhes lte bar chos 'byung dbus su padma 'dab bzhi'i lte bar hrīḥ 'dab bzhir ha ri ni sa/ hrīḥmathar sngags phreng gi 'od kyis don gnyis sgrub par mos la/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

zhes rlung dang sbyar ba'i 'gog bzlas bya/ de nas/ rang gi thugs las ye shes 'od zer 'phros// dngos 'dzin mtshan bcas 'od gsal dbyings su sbyangs// phyi snod chos dbyings 'og min stug po bkod// gnas khang thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang*// mchod pa'i yo byad kun bzang smon lam 'phrul// phyi nang gsang ba de nyid bkod pa'i sprin// zag med bde skyed nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badzra sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ rten bskyed pa ni/ gdod nas rnam dag sangs rgyas zhing*// rlung lnga dag pa seng ge'i khri// rtsa lnga dag pa padma'i gdan// khams lnga dag pa nyi zla'i steng*// sems nyid stong pa bla ma'i sku// ye shes lus can rdo rje 'chang*// mngon shes drug ldan te lo pa// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba nā ro pa// dgyes mdzad rdo rje lho brag pa// 'gro ba'i mgon po 'dzam gling grags// bka' brgyud nor bu'i phreng ba rnams// gcig 'dus 'khor lo'i mgon po dngos// rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i zhabs// sngo sang ras dkar bla gos can// dbu skra phying bu sku rgyab grol// phyag g.yas snyan gyi thad kar bsten// g.yon pas mnyam gzhag thod zhal bsnams// zhabs gnyis phyed pa'i skyil krung mdzad// stong nyid shes rab rnal 'byor ma// sgom thag tshul gyis sku la 'khyud// ye shes 'od lnga'i gzi byin 'bar// gzhom med rdo rje'i mgur dbyangs sgrog /thugs rjes mos pa'i bu la dgongs// bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i 'khor// sprin ltar 'khrigs pa'i dbus na bzhugs// rdo rje gsum gyi 'od zer gyis// mngon dga' la sogs zhing rnams nas// spyan drangs gnyis su med par gyur// cang te'u dril bu'i sgras bskul/ dad mos gdung ba'i shugs bskyed la/ hūm̐/ chos sku mkha' khyab gshegs bzhud mi dmigs kyang*// thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gang 'dul gzugs kyi sku// mos pa'i blo dang 'tshams par rnam rol ba// dad ldan bsod nams zhing du gshegs su gsol// mngon dga' la sogs dag pa'i zhing khams nas// dbang phyug bzhad pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i gtso// bka' brgyud grub thob rgya mtsho yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro chos skyong 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// e ā ra lī pheṃ/

badzra sa mā dzaḥ rje btsun ras pa rgyal ba sras dang bcas// gdul bya'i yul la snying rjes brtser dgongs te// mchod pa'i yul du brtan par bzhugs nas kyang*// lus ngag yid la rdo rje'i byin chen phob// tiṣṭha badzra hūm̐/ sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥ rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs mchog yon tan dang*// phrin las mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bdag /skyabs gnas kun 'dus rdo rje rgyal mtshan la// sgo gsum gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo// na mo na maḥhūm̐/ zhing khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun// lha rdzas yid 'ong phyi yi mchod pa'i sprin// kun bzang rnam par rol pas bkang ste 'bul// tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs chos kyi rgyal por shog /phung khams skye mched 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// rang bzhin rnam dag rdo rje'i pho nya mo// nam mkha' gang bas bla ma'i 'khor lor mchod// dug lnga rang grol sku lnga thob par shog /thabs shes zung 'jug 'gyur med lhan cig skyes// bde stong ye shes chen po'i dga' ston la// zag med ting 'dzin rol pas dbang bsgyur nas// srid pa'i sdug bsngal 'ching las grol bar mdzod// gang la thog mtha' dbus med 'khor 'das med// chos kun rang bzhin gnyug ma phyag rgya che// yid byed las 'das 'khor gsum rnam par dag /rang bzhin lhun grub mchod pa chen po'o// oṃ badzra sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ phyi nang gsang ba'i maṇḍal ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gling bzhi'i 'jig rten rab 'byams rgyud mtshams sbyor// rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i zhing gi 'byor pa'i tshogs// ma lus blo yis blangs te 'bul lags na// de snyed 'gro kun thugs rjes bzung du gsol// bdag lus longs spyod bdog pa ci mchis dang*// phung khams skye mched 'phral yun 'dun mar bcas// bdag tu bzung ba'i dngos por gyur tshad kun// 'bul gyis bdag 'dzin zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// dngos dang dngos min mtha' las yongs grol zhing*// skye 'gag gnas gsum 'gro 'ong rtag chad kyi// ming mtshan las 'das gnas lugs maṇḍal mchog

/phul bas rje btsun khyed dang dbyer med shog /oṃ gu ru ratna maṇḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ bstod pa ni/ gu ru na mo hūm̐/ snying rje chen po sems chen po// dmigs pa chen po blo chen po// go cha chen po mtshon chen po// dpa' chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// dad pa chen po gus chen po// dam tshig chen po brtul zhugs che// brtson 'grus chen po stobs chen po// skyes mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// shes rab chen po thabs chen po// bde ba chen po gsal ba che// stong pa chen po rgya chen po// thub chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// theg pa chen po sa chen po// lam chen ye shes chen po ste// yon tan chen po snyan grags che// bdag chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhing khams chen po stong pa che// rdzu 'phrul chen po gdul bya che// byin rlabs chen po don chen po// skyabs chen khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku chen gzi brjid chen po pa// gsung dbyangs chen po 'od po che// mkhyen pa chen po mthu stobs che// dpal chen khyed la phyag 'tshal bstod// byang phyogs mun pa'i smag rum na// gangs la nyi ma shar 'dra ba// thos pa dga' zhes bya ba yi// skyes bu de la phyag 'tshal bstod// slar yan lag bdun gyis tshogs bsags pa ni/ 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang na// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// rang sems chos sku mngon sum ston mdzad pa// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la phyag 'tshal// lus dang longs spyod yid kyis sprul pa yi// mchod pa kun gyis mchod cing bstod par bgyi// sngar byas sdig pa ma lus so sor bshags// sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do// 'gro kun dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// byang chub mchog gi rgyur ni bsngo bar bgyi// mya ngan mi 'dar bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// theg mchog bla med chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// byams dang snying rje phyogs med 'byongs pa dang*// don dam lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de// rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis rtogs pa ltar// bdag gis mngon sum rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// sgyu lus sprul skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// srog rtsol longs skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// rang sems chos skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// sku gsum dbyer med 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/

/de nas bla ma'i dkyil 'khor dang rang gi sems/ gnyug ma gshis kyi gnas lugs gsum po dbyer med phyag rgya chen po'i lta ba rang byung rang bab bcos med du bskyang la/ oṃ āḥgu ru hā sa badzra hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzla/ gzhan yang gsol 'debs kyi bzlas pa bka' brgyud rin po che'i gsung byin rlabs dang ldan pa/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// tshig 'go 'gres sbyar la/ bla ma kun khyab chos kyi sku la= bla ma bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la= bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la= zhes ma nam bzhi bskor ci nus bsags la mos gus kyi rtsal bskyed/ bdag dang sems can thams cad blo chos su 'gro bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ chos lam du 'gro bar= lam 'khrul pa sel bar= 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char bar= bdag gi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa dang*/ bag chags kyi sgrib pa thams cad da lta nyid du dag par= 'dug sa 'di nyid du dag par= thun 'di nyid du dag par= bdag gi rgyud 'di dag par= rgyud 'di rnam par grol bar= da lta nyid du grol bar= 'dug sa 'di nyid du grol bar= thun 'di nyid du grol bar= bdag gi rgyud la ting nge 'dzin mchog tu gyur pa phyin ci ma log pa skye bar= da lta nyid du skye bar= 'dug sa 'di nyid du skye bar= thun 'di nyid du skye bar= ye shes mchog tu gyur pa phyin ci ma log pa skye bar= da lta= 'dug sa= thun 'di nyid du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gong dang sbrel la tshar grangs gang nus kyis gsol gdab/ rgyas par spro na 'dir rje btsun mi la'i gsol 'debs dmigs bsal rgyas bsdus gang shes bya/ snying po lta bu rje brgyad pa'i gsung ni/ byang phyogs rgyud du sku 'khrungs shing*// 'jig rten skyon gyis ma gos par// dka' ba spyad pa'i ngo mtshar can// mi la mchog la gsol ba 'debs// bde chen brjod med ro yis myos// srid gsum dag pa'i phyag rgyas bcings// bsreg bzhu'i lam nas lhan cig skyes// mi la mchog la=

rags snang phra thig zab mor bsten// phra myong bdag byin brlab par mdzad// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rigs kyi bdag /mi la mchog la= 'dzag med gtso mor sa bon bkrol// srid bdag lam du snying rjes len// nus pa drag po'i skur bzhengs pa// mi la mchog la gsol ba 'debs// bdag kyang 'khor ba mi spong zhing*// myang 'das zhi bar mi 'jug ste// mkha' spyod dbang phyug mi la yi// mchog gi dngos grub 'grub gyur cig / zhes dang*/ rje mi la bzhad pa rdo rje la gsol ba 'debs so// zhes gdung shugs drag pos phur tshugs gsol ba ci nus gdab mthar/ rje sku tshe gcig la sangs rgyas nas/ mtshan thos tshad 'khor ba dong sprugs pa// rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug rin po che// dpal bzhad pa rdo rje sprul pa'i sku// pha rje btsun ras pa chen po la// bu mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs// yid the tshom med pa'i blo gtad zhu// dus 'di phyi kun tu thugs rjes zungs// tshe long med mi rtag skyo shas skyes// blo dam pa'i chos su 'gro ba dang*// lam dman dang log par mi gol bar// chos byas tshad lam du 'gro ba dang*// las rgyu 'bras blang dor mi 'chol zhing*// rgyud sdom pa dam tshig rnam par dag /tshogs zag bcas zag med yongs su rdzogs// phyi chos brgyad nyon mongs 'ching las grol// nang zhu bde'i lam gsang mtha' ru phyin// don rang rig gnyug ma phyag rgya che// gshis sku gsum rtsal snang chos nyid rgyan// rje ras pa chen po'i gsang gsum dang*// dbyer mi phyed rang rig snying dbus sad// dus skad cig mngon par sangs rgyas te// ma mkha' khyab 'gro ba 'dren nus pa'i// mchog thun mong dngos grub ma lus pa// stan 'di ru thob par byin gyis rlobs// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru ratna sarba siddhi hūm̐/ skabs 'dir spro na tshogs kyi yo byad gang 'byor bsang sbyang*/ ma dag dri sbyangs ye shes bhandha'i nang*// tshogs rdzas dam ye dbyer med bdud rtsi'i mtsho// 'dod yon rnam pa dpag med 'char ba yis// bla med bla ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyes byed gyur/
oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum/ byin rlabs 'bebs pa ni/

gnas rang bzhin rnam dag chos kyi dbyings// yul dngos 'dzin bral ba'i zhing khams nas// don chos sku spros dang bral ba'i gdangs// rje ye shes sgyu 'phrul ras pa che// pha bka' brgyud bla ma yi dam lha// ma gnas gsum ḍā ki chos skyong bcas// gnas dam tshig gtsang ma'i tshogs khang 'dir// bu mos gus gdung bas spyan 'dren na// sku gsal stong 'ja' 'od lams se lam// gsung rdo rje'i mgur dbyangs kyu ru ru// thugs bde stong ting 'dzin ya la la// mchog thun mong dngos grub sha ra ra// mchog ye shes byin chen thibs se thib// tshogs 'khor lo'i 'du bar gshegs su gsol// phyi gnas khang 'og min mkha' spyod zhing*// nang mched lcam dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// bcud zag med ye shes bdud rtsi che// don lhan skyes chos sku rjen pa ru// dus stan thog 'di ru byin gyis rlobs// tshogs rdzas rnams cha gsum du bgos pa'i phud bla ma'i maṇḍal gyi drung du phul la/ ho/ tshogs mchod zag med bdud rtsi'i mtsho// ye shes rol pa'i mchod sprin 'di// skyabs gnas kun 'dus 'gro ba'i mgon// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug ras pa che// rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje dang*// yi dam dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma// chos srung bka' sdod bcas la 'bul// bka' brgyud grub thob rgya mtsho bskang*// tshe gcig mngon 'tshang rgya bar mdzod// rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs bskang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bskang*// phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med sgrubs// chos skyong bka' sdod 'khor bcas bskang*// bstan la gnod pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol// dam tshig chags nyams sor chud nas// skye med chos sku mngon gyur shog /ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ bar pa dam tshig gi rdzas su rol la/ ho/ rang lus gdan gsum tshang ba'i lhar// nang gi sreg blugs phul ba yis// myur du rdo rje'i lam bgrod nas// phyag rgya chen po 'grub gyur cig

/ lhag ma rnams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs nas/ tshogs lhag ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// gnas yul dur khrod 'jig rten khams nyul ba'i// bstan srung rnal 'byor skyong ba'i tshogs la 'bul// tha tshig ma bsnyel rnal 'byor grogs mdzod cig / ces bsngo'o// rjes kyi bya ba ni/ rje btsun ras pa rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyis// bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis rlobs// gsol ba btab pas 'khor rnams 'od du zhu// gtso bo'i skur thim de yi gnas gsum nas// byin rlabs 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros// bdag gi gnas gsum la thim sgo gsum gyi// sgrib dag bum gsang sher ye'i dbang mchog thob// sku gsum mngon du byed pa'i skal can byas// mos gus shugs kyis rje btsun 'od du zhu// spyi bo nas zhugs rang dang dbyer med 'dres// lhan skyes sgrib dag don gyi dbang bzhi thob// ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag /gsang gsum sgo gsum dbyer med ro gcig gyur// don dam chos sku blo bral bde ba che// yid la mi byed gnyug ma lhan cig skyes// snang srid phyag rgya chen po e ma ho// zhes ma bcos tha mal gnyug ma'i shes pa ci gnas su bskyang zhing*/ rjes thob tu snang srid bla ma chos sku'i rol par lam du khyer/ chos brgyad la thog brdzis btang*/ 'dir snang gi 'khri ba bcad/ dag snang dang mos gus rgyun chad med pas bsgom med yengs med kyi dran shes chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du brtan nas/ gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po'i gtan srid tshe gcig la zin par bya'o// bsngo smon ni/ dge ba 'di dang dus gsum bsags pa yi// dge kun sras bcas rgyal bas bsngos pa ltar// mi gnas byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi// zung 'jug go 'phang tshe 'dir 'thob par shog /sgrub la brtson pa mthar phyin zhing*// 'khrul pa'i sa bon rgyun chad nas// rje btsun ras pa chen po dang*// rnam thar phrin las mnyam gyur cig

/ shis pa brjod pa ni/ bka' brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs sprin chen 'khrigs// yi dam lha tshogs dngos grub char rgyun 'bebs// mkha' 'gro chos skyong phrin las 'bras bu smin// don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / dkyil 'khor kun gtso bla ma sgrub pa ni// rgyal bas rgyud sde kun nas yang yang bsngags// bla ma grub pa'i dbang phyug mi la rje// mtshan tsam thos kyang skye ba bdun brgyud du// ngan song skye sgo gcod par zhal gyis bzhes// da lta zung 'jug chen po'i rgyal sar bzhugs// 'khor 'das brtan g.yo ma lus byin gyis brlabs// gsol ba btab na thugs rjes nges par gzigs// byin rlabs zil chen dad ldan yongs la 'bebs// de phyir sgrub brtson rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog /snang rtse'i ri khrod zhabs kyis ring mo nas// bskul ngor rje btsun ras pa'i bka' brgyud pa// karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho yis// dpal spungs yang khrod de wī ko ṭi'i tshal// tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su// sbyar 'dir 'brel tshad 'gro ba ma lus pa// rje btsun ras pa chen pos rjes 'dzin shog/ //
